description: Creation of vehicular access to the house from Sonia Gardens
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01A; block plan; location plan, received 1 April 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved drawings, the boundary wall shall be lowered in height to no more than 600 mm for a distance of 2.4 metres either side of the access point before the access is brought into use and no obstruction to visibility shall be allowed to grow or be put in place in a triangular area either side of the access pont with a width of 2.4 metres and a depth of 2.4 metres measured at right angles into the site from the line of the boundary wall  and this shall be maintianed permanently.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the terms of the Town and Country Planning (General Peermitted Development) (England) Order 2015 and any successor legislation, the extent of paving on the forecourt of the property shall not be increased beyond the extent existing at the time of this decision and the surfacing shall remain permeable to the flow of water and shall not drain to any area beyond the edges of the site or either directly or indirectly into the existing :public surface water draiiniange system.
